description: Chain-break map of Rnr2 helix alphaB in the heterodimer versus the Rnr2 homodimer
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def obs(pid):
    ch={}
    for ln in open(f"prov/{pid}.pdb"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[17:20].strip() in AA3 and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            ch.setdefault(ln[21],set()).add(int(ln[22:26]))
    return ch
h=obs("1JK0"); m=obs("1SMQ")
tracks=[("1JK0 chain A\nRnr2 with Rnr4 present",h['A'],"#2166ac"),
        ("1SMQ chain A\nRnr2 homodimer",m['A'],"#b2182b"),
        ("1SMQ chain B\nRnr2 homodimer",m['B'],"#b2182b"),
        ("1SMQ chain C\nRnr2 homodimer",m['C'],"#b2182b"),
        ("1SMQ chain D\nRnr2 homodimer",m['D'],"#b2182b")]
rng=range(132,165)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4.2))
for k,(lab,s,col) in enumerate(tracks):
    y=len(tracks)-1-k
    for r in rng:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((r-0.45,y-0.35),0.9,0.7,
                     facecolor=col if r in s else "#e8e8e8", edgecolor="white"))
ax.set_xlim(131.3,164.7); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,len(tracks)-0.4)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(tracks))); ax.set_yticklabels([t[0] for t in tracks][::-1],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(list(rng)[::2]); ax.set_xticklabels([str(r) for r in list(rng)[::2]],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Rnr2 residue number")
ax.axvline(145,color="k",lw=1.2,ls="--")
ax.text(145,len(tracks)-0.3,"Asp145, iron ligand",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Helix alphaB of Rnr2 is ordered only when Rnr4 is present\n"
             "Filled: C-alpha observed in the crystal. All four chains of the Rnr2 homodimer break at 145-149.",fontsize=11)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("1JK0 A missing in 140-155:",[r for r in range(140,156) if r not in h['A']])
print("1SMQ A missing in 140-155:",[r for r in range(140,156) if r not in m['A']])
